evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel logging callback dispatch boundary to run without holding the logger mutex.
rationale: Fixes re-entrant deadlocks where external applications hang if a log callback emits a message or finalizes an object. As noted in the description, language bindings running garbage collection finalizers during callbacks (PR #34775, PR #34374) reproduce this deadlock directly, making thread-safety at the boundary crucial for library consumers.
